correctness.rationale: Containment of a second boundary point c+Av in the radius-r inward-normal ball is equivalent to r >= q ||A(u-v)||^2/||u-v||^2, q=||A^{-1}u||. Every unit secant direction z with <u,z> >0 is realized by v=u-2<u,z>z; its Rayleigh quotient attains supremum a^2, including by approach along the tangent equator. Equality of the quotient identifies exactly top-eigenspace directions and therefore all and only the remote contacts. Converting normal to support gives q=1/||A nu||; range [a,a^2/b]. Tangent-plane limits give R_loc=q max_{z perp u}||Az||^2, with equality to R_* iff W intersects u-perp. Independent exact rational tests of secant inequalities and reflected equality in dimensions 2--4 covered 958 cases; the universal proof is analytic.
